tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: From the same team behind Corima, this casual, daytime tortilleria in Park Slope is all about house-made flour tortilla burritos. Order at the counter and find a table inside or out (when the weather is nice), then settle in and watch the team at work as they assemble orders. One bite in and you'll know what makes this place stand out — it's those precise and pliable tortillas, of course. Try the breakfast-style burnt ends burrito filled with tender pulled meat, scrambled eggs and cheddar cheese or the verde burrito featuring braised pork shoulder tossed with salsa verde and diced potatoes. Finish with one of their house-made cinnamon rolls, generously coated in cream cheese frosting finished with a sprinkling of sea salt.
